notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id. Shape copied from arm9/ActorBase, arm9/Model4 and arm9/Message2.

Supersedes the single-function entry arm9/_ZN11fLiNdBaPr_cD1Ev (0x020440e8..0x02044104), which claimed fLiNdBaPr_c::D1 was its own file. Its cited note (notes/mangled-fold-decisions.md) is not in the tree, and its argument -- the next function does the same thing to the same global -- is evidence for one file, not two. That entry is removed so the range has one owner.

pragma defer_codegen off for the whole file: definitions are written in ROM-ascending order. func_02044284 needs opt_common_subs off (as its legacy source did file-wide) while func_020441cc and func_02044334 need it on. Under default deferred codegen a push/pop around func_02044284 did not take effect (it differed) and a file-wide off broke the other two; with codegen not deferred, the push/pop scopes it to that one function and all 8 match.

data_020a4b68 is declared once as void *, the spelling ActorBase.cpp, ShowCrashScreen.c and the fLiNdBaPr_c shard used. The fLiNdBa_c shard's fLiNdBa_c * spelling is retired; the comparison against `this` converts implicitly and the bytes are unchanged.

Static initializer folded: the five process-list heads are defined in this TU. data_020a4b6c is the 3-word process-tree sentinel (head, callback); data_020a4b88, data_020a4b78, data_020a4b98 and data_020a4ba8 are the 4-word list sentinels (head, tail, callback). Inline constructors copy the extern pointer-to-member constants data_02099f60, data_02099f70, data_02099f48, data_02099f68 and data_02099f50 and zero the links, so mwcc emits __sinit_fListNode.cpp. The handwritten src/unnamed/arm9/0207/__sinit_02075154.c is retired. The emitted .init, .ctor and .bss are byte- and relocation-identical to retail; nothing is registered because the sentinels have no destructor. The PMF constants stay extern: they are interleaved with the phase-name strings data_02082178 points at, and this TU does not emit them. ActorBase.cpp still declares the heads int []; that spelling is banked. decl_common.h still declares data_020a4b6c as int, which is the plurality.

The three helpers func_0204424c, func_02044284 and func_02044334 now share one local layout, Obj (the two legacy files each had their own Obj with the same field offsets). func_0204424c keeps its char * parameter because ActorBase.cpp and the port bridge declare it that way.
Function names stay as linker names (func_*). The roles in comments are read from the bytes; no original names are claimed.
